summary.result: Using this system, the water supply capacity in the Geum River estuary reservoir was analyzed.
summary.background: In order to analyze the water supply capacity in an estuary reservoir, a system composed of daily water balance model and daily inflow model was developed.
summary.method: The DAWAST model (Noh, 1991) was selected to simulate daily estuary reservoir inflow, wherein return flows from agricultural, domestic, and industrial water were included to simulate runoff.
